messages:
Carmen Ruiz: hey team, i'm Carmen (started today). opened a tiny PR but Buildkite checkout failed with 403. not sure whom to ask for CI access.
Buildkite Bot: Build #205 (carmen/docs-typo) failed · exit code 128 · logs: https://buildkite.com/redwood-inference/pipeline/builds/205
Carmen Ruiz: checkout error: 
```
remote: HTTP Basic: Access denied
fatal: Authentication failed for 'https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs.git/'
```
Priya Patel: welcome Carmen! :wave: first guess: org team membership. Did you add your SSH key? Also double-check you're in eng-ci.
Carmen Ruiz: yes added SSH key but i'm not in any teams yet. i thought onboarding would auto-add me.
Samir Rao: hi Carmen, welcome! we add folks on the first-day batch but sometimes theres a lag. i'm adding you to eng-ci and to the Buildkite pipeline team now.
Priya Patel: FYI we rotated the org deploy token last week. New hires after that need explicit team membership.
Samir Rao: added. also changed the pipeline to prefer the org deploy token for HTTPS checkout so personal keys aren't required. re-run should pass.
Carmen Ruiz: re-ran and now it's failing on a flaky pytest: 
```
E  AssertionError: expected 200 but got 502 intermittently
```
Priya Patel: that 502 is from the internal mock service flake. For CI runs mark the job as retry-on-fail or run with SKIP_MOCKS=1 when doing docs-only changes.
Samir Rao: i retriggered with SKIP_MOCKS=1 and it went green. Build link: https://buildkite.com/redwood-inference/pipeline/builds/206
Buildkite Bot: Build #206 (carmen/docs-typo) passed · duration 4m
Carmen Ruiz: thanks so much! one more Q: for editing CI templates in infra/ci-templates, do i need extra perms?
Priya Patel: you'll need write access; protected branches may also require a maintainer approval. ping eng-infra if it blocks you.
Carmen Ruiz: got it. marking CI access done on my checklist. thanks again!
